Companion Animal Travel Desk quiet month care standards

Purpose: this section sets the daily handling rules for calm, clear, and safe service at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Keep the counter area orderly, speak in a low and steady voice, and give each traveler the same basic steps in plain words. The service treats each journey as a shared responsibility, so staff must check travel notes, confirm crate or carrier details, and record any service changes in the desk ledger before the case moves on. If a passenger arrives with a pet that needs extra care, stay practical and kind, and keep the discussion focused on the travel task. <<FACT F077>> Do not add side comments or guesswork, since the record must stay clean and usable for the next shift.

When a traveler brings documents, review them against the booking record and note any mismatch right away. If the carrier looks damaged, if the animal seems unsettled, or if the traveler needs a clearer step-by-step handoff, pause the process and bring in the senior coordinator. Staff should avoid crowded talk near the desk, because a quiet setting helps the traveler and the animal stay settled. Use direct phrases, repeat only what matters, and make sure the traveler knows what happens next before the case leaves your station.

Benny may be mentioned in training examples, but the desk record itself should always stay focused on the current traveler and pet. If a traveler has a service change, write it in full and keep your note brief, readable, and complete. Do not leave open questions in the ledger, and do not pass along a case until the basics are checked and signed off.

For anything unclear, contact the senior coordinator or the shift lead at once.
